shots.focal_element: Kubernetes integration card with its Install button under the hand cursor in the Marketplace search results
shots.typography: Only overlay caption counted (product UI text not transcribed). Caption appears in the last frame: very large heavy/extra-bold sans, sentence case, tight tracking, brand-coloured fill with a soft light halo, centred over the UI. Font guess (low confidence): a geometric grotesk such as the brand sans.
shots.what_happens: A floating, rounded-corner Datadog Marketplace window (search 'Kubernetes', category chips, results grid) sits on a gradient backdrop; the hand cursor moves to the Kubernetes card, which expands to show an INSTALL button, clicks it, and the Kubernetes integration modal opens as the 'Get started sooner' caption fades in on top (VO w84-w87 'Find what you need faster,').
shots.build_rebuild: Place a screen-recording video in an inset rounded card with drop shadow over an animated gradient, animate a hand-cursor sprite to the target card, and on click cross-fade to the modal state while fading in a centred bold caption with a light glow.

shots.focal_element: Kinetic caption 'Get started sooner' layered over the Kubernetes integration modal and its Install Integration button
shots.typography: Very large heavy/extra-bold sans, sentence case, tight tracking, brand-coloured fill with a soft light outer glow so it reads over busy UI; single centred line. Font name not identifiable (low-confidence guess: brand geometric sans).
shots.what_happens: The Kubernetes modal (Data Collected tab, metrics table) is shown with the caption held centred; the cursor clicks 'Install Integration', the badge flips from AVAILABLE to a green INSTALLED badge and the modal switches to the Assets tab listing dashboards, while the UI starts to scale up toward full frame (VO w88-w90 'get started sooner,').
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the caption layer fixed and centred with a text-shadow glow above the screen-recording layer, cut the recording to the post-click state (INSTALLED badge, Assets tab), and begin a scale-up of the UI card on the last frames.

shots.focal_element: Assets tab dashboards list with the 'Kubernetes - Overview' row hovered by the hand cursor
shots.transition_other: Continuous push-in on the UI card: the caption disappears and the backdrop shifts to a different gradient while the card scales up past the frame edges
shots.what_happens: Zoomed-in view of the installed Kubernetes integration (INSTALLED badge, Assets tab, 'Dashboards' list); the camera keeps pushing in, the cursor moves to and clicks 'Kubernetes - Overview', and the dashboard (Clusters 13, Namespaces 43, Services 685, Deployments 492) appears in the final frame (VO w91-w94 'and monitor right out').
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a scale transform from about 1.0 to 1.4 on the UI card anchored top-left over the shot, move a cursor sprite to the first table row, add a row hover highlight, then swap the recording to the dashboard view on click.

shots.focal_element: Kubernetes - Overview dashboard with large count tiles (Clusters 13, Namespaces 43, Services 685, Deployments 492)
shots.what_happens: A roughly two-frame flash of the Kubernetes - Overview dashboard filling the frame, cropped on the left and right edges, bridging the click in s014 to the zoom-out in s016 (around w95 'of'). Only a keyframe was available; no contact sheet for this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 2-frame full-bleed crop of the dashboard recording at high scale as a bridge frame before the zoom-out transition.

shots.focal_element: Headline 'Monitor right out of the box' above a stack of Kubernetes dashboards that slide in one after another
on_screen_text: Monitor right out of the box
shots.typography: Large bold sans headline, sentence case, normal-to-tight tracking, light fill on the gradient, centred at the top third; product UI text not transcribed. Font guess (low confidence): brand geometric sans.
shots.what_happens: The camera pulls out so the dashboard sits as a card below a top headline on the gradient backdrop; the Kubernetes - Overview dashboard (13 / 171 nodes / 43 / 73 / 685 / 492 / 4138) is replaced by a Kubernetes Pods Overview card sliding up from the bottom, then by a Kubernetes Services Overview card (big '694' tile), each stacking over the previous (VO w96-w97 'the box.', then music only).
shots.build_rebuild: Pin the headline at the top, place dashboard screenshots as cards in the lower area, and every ~1.3 s slide the next card up from below the frame with an ease-out so it covers the previous card, leaving a sliver of the old header visible.

shots.focal_element: Centred two-line closing statement on a soft animated gradient
shots.transition_other: Previous shot blurs out (headline and dashboard defocus) into a full-frame soft gradient before the text appears
on_screen_text: can help you consolidate your tools
shots.typography: Two-line centred lockups in a semibold/bold humanist sans, sentence case, normal tracking, light fill; first lockup uses a small lead-in line ('Discover how') over a larger second line, second lockup uses two equal-size lines. Font guess (low confidence): the brand sans.
shots.what_happens: The dashboard frame blurs away to a drifting gradient; 'Discover how / Datadog's ecosystem' appears and slowly scales down, then is replaced by 'can help you / consolidate your tools', both timed to the VO w98-w108 'Discover today how Datadog's ecosystem can help you consolidate your tools.'
shots.build_rebuild: Over a slowly drifting blurred radial-gradient background, show two centred text lockups in sequence, each fading in with a slight scale-down (about 1.05 to 1.0) and swapping at the word 'can' (w103).
